task.description: Diagnose mismatch between webhook delivery status vocabulary in test assertions vs. database CHECK constraint and dispatcher.
acceptance_criteria: Category assigned per WF-03 diagnosis table

result.summary: Category D (test error): dispatcher.zig was fixed by ISS-0205 to write uppercase status values (PENDING, DELIVERED, FAILED) matching the CHECK constraint in migration 085. The test file ext02_webhook_dispatch_test.zig was NOT updated to match -- three assertions still expect legacy lowercase/obsolete values. Fix scope: update 3 expectEqualStrings calls in ext02_webhook_dispatch_test.zig only.

issues.description: ext02_webhook_dispatch_test.zig line 589: expectEqualStrings("failed", status_500) -- dispatcher writes FAILED (uppercase); test expects failed (lowercase). Fix: change expected string to "FAILED".

ext02_webhook_dispatch_test.zig line 654: expectEqualStrings("exhausted", delivery_status) -- the value "exhausted" was remapped to "FAILED" by migration 085 step 3 and is not in the CHECK constraint domain (PENDING,DELIVERED,FAILED,RETRYING). When should_pause=true, dispatcher writes FAILED to webhook_deliveries. Fix: change expected string to "FAILED".

ext02_webhook_dispatch_test.zig line 754: expectEqualStrings("success", delivery_status) -- the value "success" was remapped to "DELIVERED" by migration 085 step 3 and is not in the CHECK constraint domain. Dispatcher writes DELIVERED for a successful delivery. Fix: change expected string to "DELIVERED".

result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV (WF-03 Step 2) -- fix 3 assertions in ext02_webhook_dispatch_test.zig
